policies.title: Shipping Policy
policies.content:
DTF Genetics · Store policy

Shipping Policy

Last updated: August 23, 2026.

DTF Genetics ships only to destinations made available through the live checkout. Shipping availability, carrier options, charges, taxes, and any destination restrictions shown at checkout control the transaction.

Order processing

Orders are prepared after payment and order review. Any processing or delivery estimate shown during checkout or in an order message is an estimate rather than a guaranteed arrival date unless DTF Genetics explicitly states otherwise in writing.

Destination and legal restrictions

Customers are responsible for confirming that the products they order may lawfully be purchased, possessed, received, and used at the destination. DTF Genetics may decline or cancel an order when fulfillment to a destination is unavailable, prohibited, or reasonably believed to create a legal or carrier-compliance problem. If DTF Genetics cancels an unfulfilled paid order, the applicable payment will be refunded through the original transaction method where practicable.

Address accuracy

Customers are responsible for entering a complete and accurate shipping address. If an address problem is identified before fulfillment, contact DTF Genetics through the current Contact page as soon as possible. DTF Genetics cannot promise that an address can be changed after an order has entered fulfillment.

Delivery problems

If an order arrives damaged, incomplete, materially different from the order confirmation, or appears lost in transit, use the Contact page promptly and include the order number and relevant details. DTF Genetics will review the shipment and provide the remedy required by the applicable order terms and law.

policies.title: Returns & Replacements
policies.content:
DTF Genetics · Store policy

Returns & Replacements

Last updated: August 23, 2026.

DTF Genetics wants the physical order you receive to match the order you placed. Because seeds and other biological or sealed products can be sensitive to storage, handling, contamination, and chain-of-custody conditions after delivery, ordinary change-of-mind returns may be restricted where permitted by law.

Wrong, damaged, incomplete, or defective-at-delivery orders

If you receive the wrong item, an incomplete order, damaged goods, or a product that was materially defective when delivered, contact DTF Genetics promptly through the current Contact page. Include the order number, a description of the problem, and photographs when they can reasonably document the issue. DTF Genetics will review the claim and provide an appropriate replacement, refund, or other remedy when required by the order terms or applicable law.

Biological variation and cultivation outcomes

Unless a specific written guarantee appears on the applicable product page or order confirmation, descriptions of lineage, generation, flowering or planning windows, aroma direction, morphology, vigor, resin production, yield potential, germination, phenotype, potency, or other biological traits are informational breeding or cultivation context rather than guaranteed individual outcomes. Genetics and environment both affect results.

Change-of-mind requests

Do not send products back without authorization. If you want to request a return or cancellation for a reason other than an order error or delivery problem, contact DTF Genetics before returning anything. Eligibility depends on order status, product condition, applicable law, and whether the product can safely and lawfully be accepted back.

Non-waivable rights

Nothing in this policy removes rights or remedies that cannot legally be waived under applicable consumer-protection law.

policies.title: Terms & Conditions
policies.content:
DTF Genetics · Store terms

Terms & Conditions

Last updated: August 23, 2026.

These terms apply to purchases and use of the DTF Genetics website. By placing an order, you agree to the terms that are displayed on the site and checkout at the time of purchase.

Lawful use and destination compliance

You are responsible for determining whether a product may lawfully be purchased, received, possessed, germinated, cultivated, transferred, or otherwise used in your location. DTF Genetics does not authorize unlawful conduct. Availability on a website does not override local, state, federal, provincial, national, carrier, import, or other applicable restrictions.

Product information

DTF Genetics works to keep product names, lineage, generation, seed type, pack details, price, availability, and educational descriptions accurate. Biological traits are inherently variable. Breeding goals, observations, planning ranges, aroma descriptions, morphology, yield potential, potency, germination, and phenotype information are not guarantees unless an explicit written guarantee is provided for the specific transaction.

Orders and pricing

The live product page and checkout control current price, stock, quantity, taxes, shipping eligibility, and transaction details. DTF Genetics may refuse or cancel an order before fulfillment when there is an obvious pricing or inventory error, suspected fraud, an unsupported destination, a legal or carrier restriction, or another material fulfillment problem. Paid amounts for an order cancelled by DTF Genetics before fulfillment will be refunded as required by applicable law and payment-network rules.

Educational content

Teaching Healthy Cultivation materials, diagnostics, calculators, charts, articles, and other educational resources are provided for general education. They do not replace professional legal, medical, safety, engineering, laboratory, agronomic, pesticide-label, or other regulated advice where such advice is required.

Intellectual property

DTF Genetics names, original graphics, written materials, games, educational content, and other original site materials may be protected by intellectual-property law. Site access does not grant permission to copy, resell, falsely attribute, or commercially exploit protected material except where an applicable license or law permits it.

Acceptable use

Do not interfere with site operation, attempt unauthorized access, submit fraudulent orders, abuse checkout or account systems, scrape protected customer information, or use the site to violate applicable law.

Liability and mandatory rights

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, DTF Genetics is not responsible for indirect or consequential losses arising from misuse of products, unlawful activity, third-party carrier failures, or reliance on generalized educational material. Nothing in these terms excludes liability or consumer rights that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited.

Changes

These terms may be updated as the store, laws, services, or fulfillment systems change. The date above identifies the current published version. Terms applicable to an already completed transaction remain subject to applicable law and the transaction records in effect at the time of purchase.

Contact and related policies

Questions about an order or these terms can be sent through the current Contact page. See also the Shipping Policy, Returns & Replacements, and Privacy Policy.

policies.title: Privacy Policy
policies.content:
DTF Genetics · Privacy

Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 23, 2026.

This policy explains the categories of information DTF Genetics may process when you browse the site, create an account, place an order, contact support, or use interactive site features.

Information you provide

Depending on the feature used, this can include name, billing and shipping address, email address, telephone number, account credentials, order details, customer-service messages, form submissions, and other information you choose to provide. Payment-card or payment-account information may be handled directly by the payment service shown at checkout rather than stored in full by DTF Genetics.

Information generated by site use

The site and its hosting, security, commerce, analytics, and performance services may process technical information such as IP address, browser or device information, requested pages, timestamps, cookies or similar identifiers, shopping-cart state, authentication state, security events, and diagnostic logs.

Why information is used

Information may be used to operate the website and store, process and fulfill orders, provide customer support, maintain carts and accounts, prevent fraud and abuse, secure the service, troubleshoot errors, comply with legal obligations, keep transaction records, and improve site performance and usability.

Service providers and disclosures

Information may be disclosed to service providers that are reasonably necessary to operate the site and complete a transaction, such as website hosting, WordPress/WooCommerce infrastructure, payment processing, shipping or delivery services, email or communications providers, security services, and technical analytics or diagnostics. Information may also be disclosed when required by law, legal process, fraud prevention, protection of rights or safety, or a legitimate business reorganization. DTF Genetics does not authorize service providers to use order data for unrelated independent resale merely because they process it on our behalf.

Cookies and local storage

WordPress, WooCommerce, security tools, analytics tools, and other site features may use cookies or browser storage for essential functions such as carts, sessions, preferences, authentication, security, performance, and measurement. Browser controls can remove or block some storage, but doing so may break account, cart, checkout, or other site functions.

Retention and security

Information is retained for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described above, including order records, tax or accounting requirements, fraud prevention, support, legal compliance, and dispute resolution. DTF Genetics uses reasonable technical and administrative safeguards, but no internet system can guarantee absolute security.

Your choices and rights

Depending on where you live, applicable law may provide rights to request access, correction, deletion, portability, restriction, objection, or information about certain disclosures. Requests can be made through the current Contact page. Identity or account verification may be required before fulfilling a request. DTF Genetics will honor applicable non-waivable privacy rights.

Children

The store is not intended to collect personal information from children who are not legally permitted to use the applicable products or services. Do not submit an order or account information if you are not legally eligible to do so.

Changes and contact

This policy may be updated when site features, service providers, legal requirements, or data practices change. The date above identifies the current published version. Privacy questions can be submitted through the Contact page.
